Title: Migrate your Azure Data Factory version 1 to 2 service (updated migration link)

Body.Content:
We introduced the Azure Data Factory version 2 in June 2018 as it provides richer capabilities. Key benefits include:

  1. Construct powerful ETL and ELT processes code-free and without maintenance
  2. Ingest all your data with 90+ built-in connectors 
  3. Orchestrate, monitor and manage pipelines visually at scale using rich control flow
  4. Get continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) for DevOps

With these enhanced functionalities, we are retiring Azure Data Factory version 1 on 31 August 2023. Please make the switch early to get the benefits of version 2 (current version).

How does this affect me?

After 31 August 2023, Azure Data Factory version 1 will not be supported.

What actions should I take?

Learn about the new code-free visual data transformation capabilities in Azure Data Factory version 2. Start migrating your Azure Data Factory version 1 to 2 service today. Download Azure Date Factory version 2 migration tool here.
